findings: Unknown simple escapes in public jv_unescape now return refusal.
jo_requote checks that a trailing backslash has a following byte before reading it.
Integer accumulation admits each next digit before multiplication, preserving the documented exact2^53 bound without signed overflow.
Parser/scanner sentinel checks and Unicode chunking were simplified; one shared decoder owns surrogate pairing.
Private local names avoid whole-source app/facade collisions. Checks remain in the existing source unit to fit the declared128-unit source graph budget.
